summary: The permanent Physics Lab office chair has a source-level ground-contact defect that current geometry coverage misses. PhysicsLabRealizer realizes every ObjectGenome component as an anchored F2 Part, not only the outer genome envelope. PhysicsLabRecipe places chair-a at y=0.54 m; office-chair.task declares a 1.08 m outer height, so the envelope bottom is correctly y=0. The five components marked externalSupport='ground' are centered at local y=-0.49 m with 0.08 m height, so their realized bottoms are y=0.54-0.49-0.04=0.01 m: all five casters float 1 cm above the floor. Active PR #302 checks only the grounded outer ObjectGenome envelope, so it would pass this defect. Active PR #311 fixes the analogous authored support/contact defect only for rollingCart. Recommend a bounded one-shot chair-support geometry lane after checking concurrent ObjectGenome work, with source scope limited to the existing officeChair fixture plus deterministic component-ground/support/COM regressions; preserve the outer envelope and advance familyVersion for any canonical fixture geometry change. This is source-only evidence and does not replace Roblox Studio contact validation.
evidence: src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabRealizer.luau realizeObject() iterates genome.components and realizes each component Part at objectTransform * component.localPositionM/component rotation.
src/shared/Physics/PhysicsLabRecipe.luau places chair-a at y=0.54 m and binds ObjectGenomeFixtures.officeChair.

src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenomeFixtures.luau officeChair dimensionsM.y=1.08; each of five externalSupport='ground' casters has localPositionM.y=-0.49 and dimensionsM.y=0.08, yielding realized caster bottom y=0.01 m while outer-envelope bottom is y=0.
PR #302 adds an all-object outer-envelope grounding assertion but no ground-declared component-contact assertion.
PR #311 adds exact rolling-cart ground-support/chassis-contact regressions and does not change the office chair fixture; open issue/PR searches found no separate current chair-caster geometry repair.
